0.0.2.en: Small tweaks and fixes for modes.

0.0.4.en: Added new math then-cards and added signals.

0.0.5.en: Fixed a few issues with cycles.

0.0.6.en: Refactored most flow cards and introduced timer cards without functionality for now.

0.2.0.en: Update the assets and branding a bit.

1.0.1.en: Added a hint to the school holiday flow card.

1.0.2.en: Fixed a bug where a token would receive the wrong value.

1.0.3.en: Fixed a translated token error where the token would not be added at all.

1.0.6.en: Added a missing null-check in timers.

1.1.0.en: This update adds two new trigger cards: 'Flag updated' and 'Mode updated'.

1.2.0.en: This update adds a new flag on/off widget for your dashboards.

1.2.2.en: Fixed a bug where the timer remaining flow card could fire multiple times. This only was the case when multiple remaining timer cards were used with the same time, for a single timer.

1.3.0.en: This update introduces a no-repeat flow card and adds translations for all supported languages.

1.3.1.en: This update introduces a no-repeat flow card and adds translations for all supported languages.

1.4.0.en: This update introduces a new no-repeat flow card as well as a new current mode dashboard widget.

1.4.1.en: This update introduces a new no-repeat flow card as well as a new current mode dashboard widget.

1.4.2.en: This update introduces a new no-repeat flow card as well as a new current mode dashboard widget.

1.4.3.en: This update introduces a new no-repeat flow card as well as a new current mode dashboard widget.

1.5.0.en: Introduces no-repeat and clear-no-repeat flow cards, a new slider widget that can be controlled from flows via the slider-set and slider-changed cards, and a new widget that shows the current mode.

1.5.2.en: Fixed a bug where the stop timer card did not properly remove a timer from the scheduler.

1.5.3.en: This update optimizes the performance of certain flag and mode trigger execution. It also fixes a bug where the timer remaining action flow card could fire twice when a timer was paused on that exact moment.

1.5.4.en: This update removes an obsolete library that was used.

1.6.0.en: This update adds the ability to customize icons and colors for flags and modes. You may customize these from app settings.

1.6.1.en: This update adds the ability to customize icons and colors for flags and modes. You may customize these from app settings.

1.6.2.en: This update adds the ability to customize icons and colors for flags and modes. You may customize these from app settings.

1.6.3.en: This update adds the ability to customize icons and colors for flags and modes. You may customize these from app settings.

1.6.4.en: No significant changes, just some internal refactorings.

1.6.5.en: Fixed a bug where non-standard languages could not properly initialize.

1.6.9.en: No significant changes, just some internal refactorings.

1.6.12.en: This update introduces a new flow trigger for when the current mode changes.

1.6.13.en: This update adds the ability to invert the cycle has value, timer is finished, timer is paused and timer is running conditions.

1.6.14.en: This update fixes a bug where modes could not be activated or deactivated while timeline notifications were disabled.

1.7.0.en: This update introduces labels, events and corresponding widgets. It also adds support for Arabic.

1.8.2.en: This update introduces a timer widget, streamlines internal logic and adds more api endpoints.

1.8.3.en: Fixed a bug where the timer count in app settings only counted non-stopped timers.

1.9.0.en: This update introduces a filter setting for the Flags-widget, this allows you to select which flags are shown in the widget. It also fixes a bug where widgets were not updated when new flags and modes were added.

1.9.1.en: This update adds more verbose logging for dianostics reports.

1.9.2.en: No significant changes, just a library version bump.

1.9.4.en: This update add internal cleanup logic and fixes a few instances where autocomplete providers did not check all flow cards.

1.9.6.en: This update adds a welcome notification with a reference to the documentation website.

1.10.0.en: This update adds a filter option to the Modes-widget.

1.10.1.en: Fixes a bug where clicks wouldn't register while using a hardware pointer on an iPad.

1.10.3.en: This update introduces a new value token to the label changed trigger.

1.10.5.en: Fixed an issue where only saved sliders were available in the slider widget.

1.11.0.en: This update adds a new utility flow card to calculate the percentage between two timestamps.

1.12.0.en: This update introduces Sets, which are groups of boolean values. It also fixes a bug with encoding of names and an issue with timers where the remaining trigger could in rare cases fire after the timer was finished.

1.12.1.en: This update introduces Sets, which are groups of boolean values.

1.12.2.en: This update introduces Sets, which are groups of boolean values.

1.12.3.en: This update introduces Sets, which are groups of boolean values.

1.12.5.en: This update improves all translations for consistency.

1.13.0.en: This update adds previous step flow cards for cycles. Event condition flow cards can now be inverted, thanks @s73nm

1.13.1.en: This update adds missing inverted condition flow card titles and makes translations a more consistent.

1.14.0.en: This update adds a new Reactivate current mode flow action.

1.15.0.en: This update introduces new activate flag/mode for [duration] flow actions, flag/mode is active for at least [duration] flow conditions. It also adds new start/set timer for a randomized duration flow actions. And last but not least, it adds a widget setting for slider step size.
1.15.0.nl: Deze update introduceert nieuwe activeer flag/stand voor [duur] flow acties, de flag/stand is actief voor tenminste [duur] flow condities. Ook worden er nieuwe start/set timers voor willekeurige duur flow acties toegevoegd. En ten slotte wordt er een widget instelling voor slider stapgrootte toegevoegd.

1.15.2.en: This update introduces a new 'Retrieve info of timer' flow action, which provides flow tokens for the timer status, remaining time and remaining seconds.

1.16.0.en: This update rewrites how app settings are rendered.

1.17.1.en: Small clarification in repeating timers feature.

1.17.2.nl: Deze update verbetert de prestaties bij het opstarten.

1.18.0.en: This update adds milliseconds as a timing unit for everything time-related, thanks @stefan-schweiger!. The Set states widget now has an opt-in setting to allow toggling states from the widget.
1.18.0.nl: Deze update voegt milliseconden toe als een tijd-eenheid voor alles tijdgerelateerd, bedankt @stefan-schweiger!. De Set statussen widget heeft nu een optie om statussen te kunnen togglen vanaf de widget.

1.18.1.en: This update fixes a bug where unneeded mode and flag updates were triggered when the name was somehow empty.
1.18.1.nl: Deze update fixt een bug waarbij onnodige mode en flag updates werden getriggert wanneer de naam leeg was.

1.18.2.en: Introduces a new at least N states in set became active trigger and a new at least n states in set are active. This update also makes the code a bit simpler.

1.19.0.en: This update adds a new calculate formula flow card, thanks @stefan-schweiger! Updated dependencies as well.
1.19.0.nl: Deze update voegt een nieuwe bereken formule flow card toe, bedankt @stefan-schweiger! Ook zijn de dependencies bijgewerkt.

1.19.1.en: Fixed a few off-by-one bugs and optimize internal logic. Update dependencies.
1.19.1.nl: Er zijn enkele bugfixes gemaakt en de interne logica is geoptimaliseerd. De dependencies zijn bijgewerkt.

1.19.4.en: Scope set states to the selected set. Update dependencies.
1.19.4.nl: Beperk set statussen tot de geselecteerde set. Dependencies bijgewerkt.

1.20.0.en: Modes now live in groups, so more than one set of modes can run at the same time. A House state group can sit next to a Lighting group without the two getting in each other's way, and your existing modes and cards keep working unchanged. Thanks to Jonathan (jmdraper on GitHub) for proposing this and for the groundwork. Flow card statistics moved to their own screen. The settings page now loads in the Homey app on iOS.
1.20.0.nl: Standen zitten nu in groepen, zodat er meerdere sets standen tegelijk kunnen draaien. Een groep Huisstatus kan naast een groep Verlichting bestaan zonder dat ze elkaar in de weg zitten, en je bestaande standen en kaarten blijven ongewijzigd werken. Met dank aan Jonathan (jmdraper op GitHub) voor het voorstel en het voorwerk. De flow kaart statistieken hebben een eigen scherm gekregen. De instellingenpagina laadt nu in de Homey app op iOS.
1.20.0.de: Modi liegen jetzt in Gruppen, sodass mehrere Sätze von Modi gleichzeitig laufen können. Eine Gruppe Hausstatus kann neben einer Gruppe Beleuchtung bestehen, ohne dass sie sich gegenseitig stören, und deine bestehenden Modi und Karten funktionieren unverändert weiter. Danke an Jonathan (jmdraper auf GitHub) für den Vorschlag und die Vorarbeit. Die Flow-Karten-Statistiken haben einen eigenen Bildschirm bekommen. Die Einstellungsseite lädt jetzt in der Homey-App unter iOS.
1.20.0.fr: Les modes sont désormais regroupés, ce qui permet de faire tourner plusieurs ensembles de modes en même temps. Un groupe État de la maison peut coexister avec un groupe Éclairage sans qu'ils se gênent, et vos modes et cartes existants continuent de fonctionner sans changement. Merci à Jonathan (jmdraper sur GitHub) pour la proposition et le travail préparatoire. Les statistiques des cartes de flux ont leur propre écran. La page des réglages se charge maintenant dans l'app Homey sur iOS.
1.20.0.it: Le modalità ora vivono in gruppi, così più insiemi di modalità possono essere attivi contemporaneamente. Un gruppo Stato casa può coesistere con un gruppo Illuminazione senza intralciarsi, e le modalità e le schede esistenti continuano a funzionare come prima. Grazie a Jonathan (jmdraper su GitHub) per la proposta e il lavoro preparatorio. Le statistiche delle schede flusso hanno una schermata dedicata. La pagina delle impostazioni ora si carica nell'app Homey su iOS.
1.20.0.sv: Lägen ligger nu i grupper, så flera uppsättningar lägen kan vara aktiva samtidigt. En grupp Hemstatus kan finnas bredvid en grupp Belysning utan att de stör varandra, och dina befintliga lägen och kort fungerar oförändrat. Tack till Jonathan (jmdraper på GitHub) för förslaget och förarbetet. Statistiken för flödeskort har fått en egen skärm. Inställningssidan laddas nu i Homey-appen på iOS.
1.20.0.no: Moduser ligger nå i grupper, så flere sett med moduser kan være aktive samtidig. En gruppe Husstatus kan stå ved siden av en gruppe Belysning uten at de er i veien for hverandre, og de eksisterende modusene og kortene dine fungerer uendret. Takk til Jonathan (jmdraper på GitHub) for forslaget og forarbeidet. Statistikken for flytkort har fått sin egen skjerm. Innstillingssiden lastes nå i Homey-appen på iOS.
1.20.0.es: Los modos ahora viven en grupos, de modo que varios conjuntos de modos pueden funcionar a la vez. Un grupo Estado de la casa puede convivir con un grupo Iluminación sin estorbarse, y tus modos y tarjetas existentes siguen funcionando igual. Gracias a Jonathan (jmdraper en GitHub) por la propuesta y el trabajo previo. Las estadísticas de las tarjetas de flujo tienen su propia pantalla. La página de ajustes ya se carga en la app de Homey en iOS.
1.20.0.da: Tilstande ligger nu i grupper, så flere sæt tilstande kan køre samtidig. En gruppe Husstatus kan stå ved siden af en gruppe Belysning, uden at de er i vejen for hinanden, og dine eksisterende tilstande og kort fungerer uændret. Tak til Jonathan (jmdraper på GitHub) for forslaget og forarbejdet. Statistikken for flowkort har fået sin egen skærm. Indstillingssiden indlæses nu i Homey-appen på iOS.
1.20.0.ru: Режимы теперь находятся в группах, поэтому несколько наборов режимов могут работать одновременно. Группа «Состояние дома» может существовать рядом с группой «Освещение», не мешая друг другу, а ваши текущие режимы и карточки продолжают работать без изменений. Спасибо Jonathan (jmdraper на GitHub) за предложение и подготовительную работу. Статистика карточек потока получила отдельный экран. Страница настроек теперь загружается в приложении Homey на iOS.
1.20.0.pl: Tryby są teraz w grupach, więc kilka zestawów trybów może działać jednocześnie. Grupa Stan domu może istnieć obok grupy Oświetlenie i nie wchodzić jej w drogę, a Twoje dotychczasowe tryby i karty działają bez zmian. Podziękowania dla Jonathana (jmdraper na GitHubie) za propozycję i przygotowanie. Statystyki kart przepływu mają własny ekran. Strona ustawień ładuje się teraz w aplikacji Homey na iOS.
1.20.0.ko: 이제 모드는 그룹에 속하므로 여러 모드 세트를 동시에 사용할 수 있습니다. 집 상태 그룹과 조명 그룹이 서로 간섭하지 않고 함께 동작하며, 기존 모드와 카드는 그대로 작동합니다. 제안과 사전 작업을 해 주신 Jonathan(GitHub의 jmdraper)님께 감사드립니다. 플로우 카드 통계는 별도 화면으로 옮겼습니다. 이제 iOS Homey 앱에서 설정 페이지가 정상적으로 열립니다.
1.20.0.ar: أصبحت الأوضاع الآن ضمن مجموعات، بحيث يمكن تشغيل أكثر من مجموعة أوضاع في الوقت نفسه. يمكن لمجموعة حالة المنزل أن تعمل إلى جانب مجموعة الإضاءة دون أن تتعارضا، وتستمر أوضاعك وبطاقاتك الحالية في العمل دون تغيير. شكراً لـ Jonathan (jmdraper على GitHub) على الاقتراح والعمل التمهيدي. حصلت إحصائيات بطاقات التدفق على شاشة خاصة بها. وأصبحت صفحة الإعدادات تُحمّل الآن في تطبيق Homey على iOS.
